theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_c1cov_lipschitz_range_c1_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), (∀ (f : Euclid n → ℝ) (K : NNReal), LipschitzWith K f → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ g : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ volume {x | f x ≠ g x ∨ fderiv ℝ f x ≠ fderiv ℝ g x} < ε) → ∀ (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (K : NNReal), LipschitzWith K F → ∃ G : ℕ → Euclid n → Euclid P, (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (G i)) ∧ μHE[n] (range F \ ⋃ i, range (G i)) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
